verdict.rationale: NetHunt's own marketing says it uses webhooks to move real-time customer data between systems, and separately says automations can fire on any CRM field change or user activity. This points to a first-party webhook capability, but the evidence never documents outbound callbacks that can be registered for specific event types. missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription API, list of subscribable event types, payload format and delivery/retry details, confirmation that webhooks are outbound rather than inbound, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Move real-time customer data from one system to another using webhooks.
Launch automated actions based on any change in Sales CRM fields or user activity.
